propPlacementRule: Position measured alpha >= 32 silhouettes relative to each camera. Keep props behind the ground; baseOcclusionPixels sets overlap. Placement is illustrative, not runtime logic.
backdropPlacementRule: Scale uniformly around bottom center; scale defaults to 1. Values above 1 crop/zoom existing pixels without adding source detail.
